# multiplier function

```{r}
get.multiples1to10 <- function(multiplier){ #multipkly integers from 1 to 10 by parameter value
   numbers <- 1:10
   return(multiplier * numbers)
}

# display results for parameter value set to 9
current_value <- 9
results <- get.multiples1to10(multiplier = current_value)
print(results)


the_filename <- paste("multiples1to10--multiplier", current_value, ".csv")
print(results, file = "myResults.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

